exec: pm.test('sorted by rupees at stake', () => { for (let i = 1; i < b.length; i++) pm.expect(b[i-1].rupees_at_stake).to.be.at.least(b[i].rupees_at_stake); });
pm.test('neutral labels only', () => b.forEach(q => pm.expect(['Needs Explanation','Recoverable under DLP']).to.include(q.status_label)));

item.name: Flagged queue - repeat bills with no complaint

exec: pm.test('billed = sum of work orders', () => pm.expect(Math.round(b.total_billed_inr)).to.eql(Math.round(b.work_orders.reduce((s, w) => s + Number(w.cost_inr), 0))));
pm.test('flags carry evidence row ids', () => b.flags.forEach(f => pm.expect(f.evidence_row_ids.length).to.be.above(0)));
pm.test('every work order has under_dlp_at_billing', () => b.work_orders.forEach(w => pm.expect(w.under_dlp_at_billing).to.be.a('boolean')));
pm.test('chronological', () => { for (let i = 1; i < b.length; i++) pm.expect(b[i-1].event_at <= b[i].event_at).to.be.true; });
pm.test('has work order events', () => pm.expect(b.some(e => e.event_type === 'work_order_completed')).to.be.true);

item.name: Draft notice - defect notice (en, by flag)

exec: pm.test('8 contractors, sorted by score', () => { pm.expect(b.length).to.eql(8); for (let i = 1; i < b.length; i++) pm.expect(b[i-1].risk_adjusted_score).to.be.at.least(b[i].risk_adjusted_score); });
pm.test('bucket A costs BMC 0', () => a.forEach(x => pm.expect(x.cost_to_bmc_inr).to.eql(0)));
pm.test('bucket A = DLP surface defects only', () => a.forEach(x => { pm.expect(x.under_dlp).to.be.true; pm.expect(['Pothole','Broken paver blocks']).to.include(x.issue); }));

pm.test('budget curve: optimizer never worse than simple rules', () => { pm.expect(b.allocation.budget_curve.length).to.be.above(0); b.allocation.budget_curve.forEach(p => { pm.expect(p.optimizer).to.be.at.least(p.volume_first_cheapest); pm.expect(p.optimizer).to.be.at.least(p.stakes_first_cheapest); }); });
pm.test('ALL bigger step + range', () => { pm.expect(b.ward_code).to.eql('ALL'); pm.expect(b.step_inr).to.eql(100000); pm.expect(b.max_inr).to.be.above(b.default_inr); });
pm.test('funded items name their ward', () => b.funded.forEach(f => pm.expect(f.ward_code).to.be.a('string')));
pm.test('months are YYYY-MM within range', () => b.months.forEach(m => { pm.expect(m.month).to.match(/^\d{4}-\d{2}$/); pm.expect(m.month >= '2025-06' && m.month <= '2025-09').to.be.true; }));

pm.test('four separate ranks, no composite', () => b.months.forEach(m => m.contractors.forEach(c => { ['speed','sla','durability','cost_alignment'].forEach(k => pm.expect(c[k]).to.have.property('rank')); pm.expect(c).to.not.have.property('risk_adjusted_score'); pm.expect(c).to.not.have.property('overall_rank'); })));

pm.test('denominators add up', () => b.months.forEach(m => m.contractors.forEach(c => { pm.expect(c.sla.known + c.sla.missing).to.eql(c.completed_jobs); pm.expect(c.evidence_work_order_ids.length).to.eql(c.completed_jobs); })));

pm.test('sorted by speed_rank, nulls last', () => b.months.forEach(m => { const r = m.contractors.map(c => c.speed.rank); const nn = r.filter(x => x !== null); pm.expect(nn).to.eql([...nn].sort((a, b) => a - b)); pm.expect(r.slice(nn.length).every(x => x === null)).to.be.true; }));

pm.test('null rank carries a reason', () => b.months.forEach(m => m.contractors.forEach(c => ['speed','sla','durability','cost_alignment'].forEach(k => { if (c[k].rank === null) pm.expect(c.rank_eligibility[k].reason).to.be.a('string'); }))));

pm.test('one contractor, ascending months', () => { pm.expect(b.contractor_id).to.eql('CT04'); b.months.forEach(m => pm.expect(m.contractor_id).to.eql('CT04')); const ms = b.months.map(m => m.month); pm.expect(ms).to.eql([...ms].sort()); });
pm.test('evidence IDs are work orders', () => b.months.forEach(m => m.evidence_work_order_ids.forEach(id => pm.expect(id).to.match(/^WO/))));

pm.test('four dimensions with directions', () => { const d = pm.response.json().dimensions; pm.expect(d.map(x => x.key)).to.eql(['speed','sla','durability','cost_alignment']); d.forEach(x => pm.expect(x.direction).to.be.oneOf(['lower is better','higher is better'])); });
pm.test('K/W localities with alias arrays', () => { pm.expect(b.length).to.be.above(0); b.forEach(l => { pm.expect(l.ward_code).to.eql('K/W'); pm.expect(l.aliases).to.be.an('array'); }); });
